name: questline
description: Questline turns vague prompts into durable goal chains with clarified scope, subgoals, execution, and critic validation.

interface.shortDescription: Clarify vague work into durable goal chains.
interface.longDescription: Questline provides a /questline workflow that clarifies ambiguous prompts, records constraints and non-goals, decomposes work into verifiable subgoals, executes them in dependency order, and uses critic subagents when validation cannot be made concrete.
defaultPrompt: /questline Build the feature I described, clarify gaps first.
/questline Refactor this repo toward the target architecture.
/questline Turn this vague idea into verified work.
